about: internal/linked's stamp (generated.sum): it vouches for the checked-in generated Go only for the generation it records, so TestLinkedGoIsFresh can skip the regeneration in the fast tier without passing a stale file.

mutants.name: linked-fresh-inputs-ignored
mutants.rule: A stamp vouches only while the generation's inputs digest is the stamped one.

mutants.name: linked-fresh-hash-ignored
mutants.rule: A stamp vouches only for files whose bytes hash as stamped (a hand edit of a generated file is a miss).
